title: CT radiomics model predicts tumor regression grade in gastric cancer neoadjuvant therapy
summary: 373 patients with advanced gastric cancer from five cohorts were studied: three retrospective neoadjuvant chemotherapy cohorts (training, internal and external validation), a prospective Dragon III cohort (NCT03636893) and a prospective SOXA cohort receiving neoadjuvant targeted therapy (ChiCTR-OPC-16010061). From 2,452 CT radiomics features per patient, mutual information and random forest selected 28 features and built the model. The model is reported to generalize across chemotherapy and targeted-therapy regimens; AUC values were not visible in the abstract excerpt.
ai_technology: Random forest on CT radiomics features selected by mutual information
